==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I see a long line of super powered warriors and aliens in the sky. They all are floating above a massive arena. A tournament is taking place.

I assume they are all robotic drones, until one of them is injured. I see their bruises and realize that they must be organic. A mad scientist races over to tend to the injured fighter.

This reminds me of a prediction I read for 2025 by someone people call "The Living Nostradamus". He claims that this year is when genetically engineered superhumans will be crafted in Asia. I wonder if that prediction inspired my dream.
